title: The Generalist’s Molt: Professional Agency and the Evolution of an ECP
content: The identity of an entomologist is rarely something one simply “acquires” in graduate school; for many of us, it is a lifelong metamorphosis. My own journey began at the age of eight, fueled by the singular obsession of a child with a net. I spent ten years in 4-H, meticulously pinning and labeling specimens, building a relationship with the natural world that later would define my entire adult life. By the time I reached my master’s program, that identity was iron-clad. I was a specialist. I was a researcher. I was an entomologist.
